summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 16, 2026, furnishing a press release under Item 8.01 announcing commercial orders rather than a corporate transaction. Its subsidiary Robotic Assistance Devices received orders for nine standalone ROSA security units licensed with SARA: six from a longstanding national automotive customer and three from an existing construction customer. All units are expected to be deployed by end of October 2026, during fiscal Q3 2027. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed. This is an ordinary product-order announcement, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
